documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences Limited reported revenue from operations of INR 682 crores for Q2 FY27, representing a 16% year-on-year growth driven by new launches and portfolio demand. Non-GPL revenue grew 20.8% year-on-year, contributing 79% of overall top-line revenue, while CDMO revenue surged 80% year-on-year to INR 50 crores. Adjusted EBITDA margin stood at 39.5% for the quarter, excluding one-time items, benefitting from lower COGS and favorable product mix. Management reiterated its full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% and EBITDA margin guidance of 35% to 36%. Phase 1 of the Solapur greenfield capacity expansion is on track to become operational in Q3 FY27.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to be in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company guides to double its CDMO business in the next 3 to 4 years to represent 12% to 15% of overall revenues.
guidance.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in sustaining momentum and delivering consistent growth based on capacity expansion and development pipeline.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: Management is guiding for full-year FY '27 revenue growth of 10% to 12% with growth skewed towards the second half.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth in the GPL business to remain flattish in FY '27 with stronger performance in H2.
guidance.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: The company expects R&D expenditure to stabilize at around 4% of revenue in the future.
guidance.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year in Q2 FY27 and accounts for 79% of total revenues.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year and now contributes 79% of our overall revenues.

demand_outlook.claim: Generic API business delivered 11% year-on-year growth in Q2 FY27 across regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: CDMO revenue reached INR 50 crores in Q2 FY27, growing nearly 80% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our CDMO business delivered a robust performance during the quarter, with revenue climbing to INR50 crores, up 32.3% quarter-on-quarter and nearly 80% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the pricing environment for generic APIs remains stable.
demand_outlook.quote: So the pricing environment, I would say, is quite stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 16.0% YoY supported by healthy demand across key markets and recent launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business delivered 26.5% year-on-year growth driven by new product launches and strong demand across geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: CVS and CNS therapies together contributed 58% to total revenue in Q1 FY '27.
demand_outlook.quote: Turning to the therapeutic mix, CVS and CNS continued to anchor growth during the quarter, together contributing 58% to the top line.

demand_outlook.claim: Chronic therapies accounted for 74% of total top line in Q1 FY '27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, chronic therapies accounted for 74% of top line in Q1 FY '27.

demand_outlook.claim: The CDMO segment grew 3.8% year-on-year in Q1 FY '27 and is expected to gain momentum in the second half of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Our CDMO business recorded 3.8% Y-o-Y growth during the first quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur facility is expected to be operational in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is on track for completion early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex incurred during Q2 FY27 was INR 105 crores and H1 FY27 capex stood at INR 190 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is considering building an oral solids formulation manufacturing facility which would take 18 to 24 months to construct.
capex_expansion.quote: Like I said, very likely that we'll take a call soon to build a formulation, oral solids facility, and we should get that done in about 18 to 24 months.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new R&D facility at Taloja in Navi Mumbai is advancing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of new R&D facility at Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is advancing as planned

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur facility is scheduled to become operational in early Q3 of FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja has begun.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR85 crores, with planned capex of approximately INR540 crores for full-year FY '27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow moment, our capex for the quarter stood at INR85 crores. We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Brownfield capacity expansions are underway adding 160KL at Dahej and 110KL at Ankleshwar.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

margins_costs.claim: Adjusted EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at approximately 39.5% excluding one-off items.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: Solvents account for 10% to 12% of raw material costs and 7% to 8% of COGS.
margins_costs.quote: The overall basket, maybe it's around 10% to 12% on our raw material cost. So on the COGS, it would be more like 7% to 8%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded to 64.4% in Q2 FY27, up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin reached 28.9% in Q2 FY27, up 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: Favorable product mix and newer launches improved gross margins to 60.2%, up 510 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Operational efficiencies and forex gains supported a 650 basis points year-on-year improvement in EBITDA margin to 36.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY '27 stood at INR24 crores, representing 3.7% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: R&D expenditure for Q1 FY '27 was INR24 crores, which was 3.7% of our sales.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter reached INR160 crores with a PAT margin of 25%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter stood at INR160 crores with PAT margins at 25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Global regulatory filings stood at over 630 DMF and CEP filings as of September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The Ankleshwar facility generates nearly 65% of total company revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Ankleshwar today contributes almost 65% to our revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The high potent API portfolio comprises 30 active products representing an addressable market of $86 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high potent API portfolio continues to advance with 30 new products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $86 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: Non-GPL business accounted for 79% of overall revenues in Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Non-GPL business now contributes 79% of our overall revenues.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's product pipeline accumulated 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio has 29 products in the active grid representing an addressable market of $82 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is actively engaged in discussions for 7 CDMO projects, while 5 projects currently generate revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: So CDMO, we have active discussions with almost about 7 projects right now, okay?

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life remains net debt-free with cash and cash equivalents of INR 1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: ROICE expanded to ~34% in H1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated free cash flow of INR90 crores during Q1 FY '27, bringing cash and cash equivalents to INR880 crores as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated a strong free cash flow of INR90 crores, leading to cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments of INR880 crores as of 30th June 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life Sciences continues to be a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Generic drug business factors in a regular level of price erosion.
risks_headwinds.quote: I mean, see, the generic business does have that, right? So we do factor in some level of erosion.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts and war situations present a risk of driving up raw material and solvent prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The GPL business saw a 52.6% year-on-year revenue decline in Q1 FY '27 due to inventory rationalization.
risks_headwinds.quote: And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Solapur manufacturing plant is expected to start operations in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management reiterated its revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

management_commitments.claim: Management guides for EBITDA margins of 35% to 36% for full year FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management guides to double the CDMO business size over the next 3 to 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: Except the fact that on CDMO, we have been guiding that we will double the business from where it is today in next 3 to 4 years' time, which would effectively contribute to about between 12% to 15% of the overall revenues is how we are looking at the CDMO business.

management_commitments.claim: The company has planned a brownfield addition of ~100KL capacity at Ankleshwar with targeted completion in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Management targets revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to make the Solapur facility operational in early Q3 of FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to incur total capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

management_commitments.claim: Management is confident in sustaining EBITDA margins within the 30% to 32% range.
management_commitments.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
